answer_1.quote: The main task of conditional natural language generation (CNLG) is to provide freedom to control the output text.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance of the generation models automatically, we use eight classifiers (one per appraisal and one for all emotions) using the remaining 20 % of the filtered crowd-enVENT dataset...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to validate the automatic evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: The survey consists of 23 statements to be rated on a five-level Likert scale. Seven statements correspond to the emotions... Seven statements correspond to the appraisal variables... and seven questions measure the text quality...
criteria: being written by a native speaker
